hero.title: Pedro Conrad Jr

hero.role: Developer of institutional systems and mobile apps

paragraphs: I am an Information Technology professional with over 20 years of experience in web systems and mobile application development. Currently, I work as an IT Analyst at Universidade Federal do Pampa (Unipampa), contributing directly to critical institutional systems.

I have strong experience in software architecture, data modeling, and development standards definition. Between 2016 and 2019, I worked in a technical leadership role, coordinating teams, leading projects, organizing processes, and mentoring developers.

My background includes the development of large-scale systems, such as ERPs with dozens of integrated modules, as well as modern mobile applications using Flutter, always focused on performance, scalability, and code quality.

sectionIntro: My experience spans within several areas within software development, with a focus on institutional solutions, mobile applications, and technical leadership.

In addition to working with software development, I have prior experience in teaching at the university level, where I lectured on technical subjects such as software development, databases, and system architecture. This experience has provided me with a solid foundation in computing fundamentals and technical communication skills.
The areas below represent some of the main domains in which I operate:

cards.title: Enterprise Systems & APIs
cards.text: Development of large-scale institutional systems and ERPs, focusing on architecture, scalability, and service integration using PHP (CodeIgniter) and relational databases.

cards.title: Mobile Applications
cards.text: Modern mobile development for Android and iOS using Flutter, including API integration, biometric authentication, and institutional services.

cards.title: Architecture & Technical Leadership
cards.text: Definition of development standards, system design, and technical leadership, focusing on quality, organization, and continuous evolution.
